2610.12293.title: Machine Learning Meets High-Energy Nuclear Physics: From Pattern Recognition to Physics-Integrated Discovery
2610.12293.paper_summary: Machine learning (ML) in high-energy nuclear physics (HENP) is entering a new stage in which physical knowledge is incorporated more directly into data analysis, simulation, and physics inference. This mini-review focuses on developments that have matured in the past several years. Whereas earlier applications emphasized event classification, pattern recognition, and surrogate models for selected observables, recent work has moved toward physics-integrated workflows: calibrated Bayesian extraction of QCD matter properties, dense-matter equation-of-state inference from heavy-ion and neutron-star data, generative event modeling, neural unfolding of weak physical signals, differentiable inverse solvers, gauge-equivariant and diffusion-based lattice-field samplers, and neural reconstruction of model functions in holographic QCD. We survey recent applications of ML in heavy-ion collisions, neutron-star physics, lattice QFT, and holographic or continuum QCD. The emphasis is not on ML architectures alone, but on how they enter concrete physics workflows, how physical constraints such as symmetries, conservation laws, causality, thermodynamic stability, and topology are imposed, and how uncertainty quantification and validation determine whether an AI-assisted result can support a reliable physics conclusion.
2610.12293.paper_summary_zh: 機器學習（ML）在高能核物理（HENP）中正進入一個新的階段，物理知識更直接地融入數據分析、模擬和物理推斷中。這篇迷你評論集中於過去幾年成熟的發展。早期的應用強調事件分類、模式識別和選定可觀測量的替代模型，而最近的工作則轉向物理整合的工作流程：經過校準的貝葉斯提取量子色動力學（QCD）物質性質、從重離子和中子星數據推斷致密物質狀態方程、生成事件建模、弱物理信號的神經展開、可微逆解算器、規範等變和基於擴散的格點場取樣器，以及在全息QCD中模型函數的神經重建。我們調查了機器學習在重離子碰撞、中子星物理、格點量子場論和全息或連續QCD中的最近應用。重點不僅在於機器學習架構本身，而在於它們如何進入具體的物理工作流程，如何施加物理約束，例如對稱性、守恆定律、因果性、熱力學穩定性和拓撲，還有不確定性量化和驗證如何決定AI輔助的結果是否能支持可靠的物理結論。
